title: Images of Noetherian spaces under continuous maps are Noetherian, and images of locally Noetherian spaces under open maps are locally Noetherian

standard_prerequisites.name: The Noetherian and locally Noetherian properties, and the correspondence between closed subsets of the image and preimages of closed subsets under a continuous map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on Noetherian topological spaces, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the two assertions and the mechanism by which chains in the image are lifted to the source.

core_obligations: Part (1): a descending chain of closed subsets of the image is pulled back along the continuous map to a descending chain of closed subsets of the source, and the Noetherian property of the source makes that chain stabilise, hence so does the one in the image (proof lines 1530-1537).

Part (2): local Noetherianness is checked point by point by taking an open neighbourhood of a point in the image which is the image of an open neighbourhood of a preimage point, using openness of the map (proof lines 1537-1541).
Conclusion: the two numbered assertions of the statement (proof line 1541).
proof_roadmap: (1) 把像中的闭集降链沿连续映射拉回源中，由源的 Noetherian 性稳定，故像中链稳定。
(2) 逐点取开邻域：由 f 的开性，像中一点的开邻域可取为源中某开邻域的像，再用源的局部 Noetherian 性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the two closure properties of the Noetherian property under images (author lemma at source lines 1520-1528, label lemma-image-Noetherian): a continuous image of a Noetherian space is Noetherian, and an open image of a locally Noetherian space is locally Noetherian. The proof (source lines 1530-1542) is short and its two halves use different hypotheses: the first pulls back a descending chain of closed subsets and uses the chain condition in the source, while the second checks local Noetherianness point by point and uses openness of the map to push open neighbourhoods forward (proof lines 1530-1541). H2.
